associations.rationale: The formal type establishes connectivity for a general McKay graph, but it does not identify finite SU(2) group families with particular affine ADE diagrams.
The formal type supplies the dimension-vector Cartan equation, a classification input, but contains no family-by-family group-to-diagram identification.
The formal type says the McKay adjacency is some affine Dynkin diagram under size and nontriviality hypotheses, but does not match every finite SU(2) group family to its ADE type.
The formal type proves symmetry of multiplicities, which supports an undirected diagram interpretation but not the requested family classification.
